what: component unavailable submission is impossible - a DB check rejects it and the SE gets HTTP 500
walk: POST /tickets/:id/troubleshoot with componentUnavailable true and a valid UUID dedup id returned HTTP 500 on 4/4 attempts across 2 covered OPEN tickets. Cause reproduced directly against Postgres in a rolled-back transaction: CHECK ts_submissions_component_unavailable_item = (component_unavailable = false OR component_unavailable_item IS NOT NULL) rejects the insert, and no caller in mobile or backend ever populates componentUnavailableItem. The harm is worse than predicted - the request does not reach the WM with a null componentId, it never reaches the WM at all. WAITING_COMPONENT, the component SLA pause and the whole component-request-to-warehouse hand-off are unreachable over HTTP, which is why /warehouse/requests and /me/component-requests are both empty.

what: troubleshoot retry mints a new dedup id, no offline queue
walk: The predicted harm - two submission rows - does NOT occur. The same clientSubmissionId twice returned result DUPLICATE, duplicate true, the SAME submissionId, no second row; the PRD:721-724 dedup contract is honoured server-side and unique-indexed. A DIFFERENT id on the same ticket returned 409 TICKET_ALREADY_CLOSED, not a duplicate row. Severity drops S3 to S2 and dangerous to false. Two residuals survive - TKT-10, and a folded validation defect: clientSubmissionId is checked for presence only and never for UUID shape, so a non-UUID id returns HTTP 500 from the Postgres uuid cast instead of 400, reproduced 4/4 at troubleshoot.controller.ts:47.

what: shadow use message on conflict screen can never render
walk: A live 409 was provoked and its body read: code TICKET_ALREADY_CLOSED, status VERIFICATION_PENDING, winnerSeId null, winnerSeName null, winnerAt null, shadowUseRecorded false. No request field can make shadowUseRecorded true because consumedComponents is absent from TroubleshootSubmitRequest, so the reassurance line is dead over HTTP. Upgraded E2 to E4.

what: a retry after the first submit shows a conflict screen blaming a null winner
walk: Because the form mints a fresh UUID per tap, a retry after a timed-out-but-succeeded submit arrives as a NEW dedup id on a ticket the SE themselves just moved to VERIFICATION_PENDING. handleConflict looks for a winner whose seId is NOT this SE, finds none, and returns winnerSeId, winnerSeName and winnerAt all null. Reproduced: the SE is shown the another-SE-won conflict screen for their own successful submission, with nobody named. This is the real cost of the unstable dedup id, and it is the only reachable route into ConflictScreen in this data since no second SE can race a covered plant.

what: SE ticket list returns the whole shared pool unpaginated - 521 rows for one plant
walk: With one MULTI_PLANT coverage row on plant 103, GET /me/tickets returned 521 items in a single response - the shared-pool branch has no take, no skip and no cursor, while the ZM's own GET /tickets pages at 100. Every unassigned OPEN ticket at a covered plant lands on the phone as workState VISIT_NOW with slaBucket null. A second covered plant multiplies it. Found only because the SE persona was given coverage for the first time; it was invisible while /me/tickets returned 0.

what: filing vehicle unavailability makes the ticket vanish from the SE's own reads
walk: GET /me/tickets/:id returned 200 before the SE filed a VU report and 404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND immediately after, because fileReport sets deferredUntil and the SE reads apply notDeferredOn(today). The SE cannot re-open, re-read or correct the ticket they just filed on; only GET /me/vehicle-unavailability still shows it. Deferring the ticket is correct - dropping the SE's read of it in the same write is the defect.

what: shared-pool read/write asymmetry not reproducible for the only work type with data
walk: The coverage floor is applied identically on read and write. Covered plant, UNASSIGNED, OPEN: GET /me/tickets/:id 200, GET /me/tickets/:id/forms 200, POST troubleshoot 201 - the read promises work the app then accepts. Uncovered plant: GET /me/tickets/:id 404 and POST soft-state 404 - refused on both sides. No promise is broken for TROUBLESHOOT, which is the hypothesis's own strongest alternative. RECOVERY and INSTALL stay NEEDS-VERIFY: all 100 tickets in this DB are workType TROUBLESHOOT, so recovery/on-site returned RECOVERY_NOT_FOUND and no install activate route resolved. Fixture that would settle it: one RECOVERY and one INSTALL ticket at a covered plant, unassigned.
